domains.name: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the core concepts and fundamental principles of artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies, establishing a solid baseline of knowledge regarding data patterns, machine learning algorithms, and predictive modeling techniques required for cloud implementations.

This domain focuses on the fundamentals of generative AI, covering advanced models, underlying architectures, and text generation concepts that drive modern applications, helping candidates understand how content creation systems operate within cloud environments.

This domain addresses the practical applications and implementations of foundation models across various use cases, ensuring candidates can successfully deploy model development pipelines, execute fine-tuning procedures, and configure retrieval-augmented generation architectures.

This domain examines the guidelines and architectural principles required for building responsible artificial intelligence solutions, emphasizing ethical design, fairness, accuracy, and the mitigation of bias across all deployed services and automated workflows.

This domain covers security, compliance, and governance frameworks for managing artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions on AWS, detailing the implementation of security guardrails, regulatory compliance standards, and organizational governance challenges.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage the 90-minute duration carefully across all 65 questions. Read each question carefully, monitor remaining time, and review flagged items before submitting your final answers.

faq.answer_text: There are 65 questions on the exam, covering five distinct domains including AI and machine learning fundamentals, generative AI, foundation models, responsible AI, and security governance.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The passing score for the exam is 700. Candidates must meet or exceed this exact numerical score to successfully earn the certification credential directly from AWS.
The certification exam has a strict duration of exactly 90 minutes, during which candidates must complete all 65 total questions within the officially allotted testing time limit.
You can find the official documentation and exam guides directly through AWS certification resources, which detail the five specific domains and their respective weight percentages.
faq.question_title: Where can I find the official exam guide?

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam, covering AI and ML fundamentals, GenAI, foundation models, and responsible AI across 65 questions.

methodology.summary: This page was constructed using verified AWS exam documentation, official domain breakdowns, and structural facts regarding test duration, passing score, and question count.

editorial.overview: The AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam, certified by AWS, evaluates candidate knowledge across five core domains. Over 90 minutes, candidates answer 65 questions to demonstrate proficiency in AI and machine learning concepts, generative AI principles, foundation model applications, guidelines for responsible AI, and security, compliance, and governance for AI solutions.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official AWS documentation and domain objectives to prepare effectively for the certification exam. Focus your study time extensively on foundation model applications, generative AI fundamentals, and responsible AI guidelines. Practice with sample questions to build familiarity with the 65-question format and manage the 90-minute limit efficiently.
editorial.who_should_take: Technology professionals, developers, and architects working with cloud workloads should take this exam. Candidates require familiarity with artificial intelligence concepts, machine learning fundamentals, and practical cloud deployments to demonstrate readiness for professional AI tasks.
